title: Northgate Tire Center Claims Adjuster Worksheet — Road Hazard Credit
content:
# Worksheet: the road hazard credit

**Definition.** On a Northgate Tire Center package, the road hazard credit is the road hazard price paid per tire multiplied by the road hazard credit share and rounded to the cent. It is worked for the most recent road hazard replacement entry recorded on the package — its wheel position, its odometer, its service date and the remaining tread measured on the damaged tire.

## Quantities

1. **Road hazard price paid per tire.** The tire unit price recorded on the package, reduced by the per-unit price adjustments and per-unit mail-in rebates recorded on the tires' purchase line for the tire item number; the tire unit price itself where there are none.
2. **Wear of the damaged tire.** The package's new tire tread depth less the remaining tread on the replacement entry, divided by the new tire tread depth less the package's coverage-end tread depth, times one hundred — a percentage of usable tread.
3. **Road hazard usable tread share.** The remaining tread less the coverage-end tread depth, divided by the new tire tread depth less the coverage-end tread depth, never below zero.
4. **Road hazard credit share.** The full share of 1 when the wear is at or below the package's full-credit wear limit; otherwise the road hazard usable tread share.
5. **Road hazard credit.** The price paid per tire multiplied by the credit share, carried at full precision and rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Judgement at the full-credit limit

| Wear compared with the package's full-credit wear limit | Credit share |
|---|---|
| at or below the limit | 1 |
| above the limit | the usable tread share |

## Worked figures (hypothetical package: new tread 10/32, coverage-end 2/32, full-credit wear limit 25 percent; price paid per tire $160.00)

| Remaining tread on the replacement entry | Wear | Credit share | Road hazard credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 8/32 | 2 divided by 8, times 100: 25 percent | 1 (at the limit) | $160.00 |
| 7/32 | 3 divided by 8, times 100: 37.5 percent | 5 divided by 8: 0.625 | $100.00 |
| 2/32 | 100 percent | 0 | $0.00 |

A tire bought at $175.00 with a $15.00 per-unit price adjustment on the purchase line has a road hazard price paid per tire of $160.00.
